Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes Use the managed workspace’s accepted upstream base for local Review diffs and commit history. **Example:** A workspace accepts an upstream commit adding upstream.txt while origin/HEAD remains stale, then adds task.txt. - **Before:** Review shows task.txt and upstream.txt, totaling two added lines. - **After:** Review shows only task.txt, totaling one added line. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | A focused, correct repair with meaningful integration coverage and the prior finding resolved; supplied behavior evidence remains harness-based. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This maintainer-authored PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate: supplied integration tests exercise the real local diff owner and Git, while inspected screenshots render those results through a mocked Gateway rather than a running Gateway. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Review attributes accepted upstream changes and commits to the current task. **Reason:** The maintainer-authored direction restores the documented task-review contract without adding configuration or another state owner. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** This PR fixes a concrete Review baseline mismatch still present on main; the prior reset finding is resolved, and no actionable introduced defect remains. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `79697e8233fd92023c8980af2a5d520dcc015c99` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The supplied evidence does not exercise the changed route through a running Gateway; the new reset regression’s pre-fix failure is not separately demonstrated.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The sessions.diff Gateway route resolves the session checkout, reads its managed workspace baseline, and asks the existing Git diff engine for files, patches, and branch history. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Control UI Review] --> B[Session diff route] B --> C[Session workspace binding] C --> D[State worker accepted base] D --> E[Existing Git diff engine] E --> F[Files patches and history] F --> A ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the accepted-base selection in the existing workspace owner and pass its recorded fact to the existing diff engine, as this PR does. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current main omits the stored accepted base, and the supplied real-Git regression constructs stale default refs that expose upstream.txt alongside task.txt; no target code was executed during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The patch restores the missing input at the local route, preserves existing diff semantics, and uses a separate read-only adapter because the provisioning owner reconciles state and excludes archived sessions. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [9ab0718cb8b7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/9ab0718cb8b74192eb62b34bff882b00b679b72b). ### Provenance checked - `Local Review baseline selection` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (2cccdd175dd502311c933319fba3c0b8ec28176e: The earlier refactor retained session and workspace authority across asynchronous reads; the existing Git engine already supported explicit repository bases.) - `Review documentation` keeps the original intent (ab26b89a6aa19bc50702f6dc505c47714f2776b1: Review follows the session’s prepared checkout and avoids showing unrelated agent workspace files.) - `Projection worker reads` keeps the original intent (cd326f915580c3e3c5c915bf4416e68a1c843089: Projection persistence and reads moved off the Gateway thread; the new narrow query uses that existing worker boundary.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Introduced change:** The pinned introduced diff supplies baseCommit to the existing diff engine through a narrow worker-backed reader; it adds no alternate diff implementation. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.ts:109`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/79697e8233fd92023c8980af2a5d520dcc015c99/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff.ts#L109), [79697e8233fd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79697e8233fd92023c8980af2a5d520dcc015c99)) - **Current main still omits the accepted base:** Main’s local route passes only cwd and sessionKey, leaving base selection to shared branch refs. ([`src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff-reset.test.ts:92`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/79697e8233fd92023c8980af2a5d520dcc015c99/src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-diff-reset.test.ts#L92), [79697e8233fd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/79697e8233fd92023c8980af2a5d520dcc015c99)) - **Accepted-base producer:** The merged refresh feature at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/174532 records the accepted base in the existing projection; this PR connects Review to that recorded fact.
